description: This header file defines the interface for creating, deleting, and managing GPU delegates in TensorFlow Lite. It provides function declarations for creating GPU delegate instances both synchronously and asynchronously (Android), as well as functions to destroy these delegates. The file also includes options to customize delegate creation through options keys and values, and handles external linkage for C compatibility.

methods.name: TfLiteGpuDelegateV2Create
methods.description: Creates a new GPU delegate instance with specified options, intended for use in the synchronous API.

methods.name: TfLiteGpuDelegateV2CreateAsync
methods.description: Creates a new GPU delegate instance with specified options, intended for use in the asynchronous API on Android.

methods.name: TfLiteGpuDelegateV2Delete
methods.description: Destroys a GPU delegate instance created with TfLiteGpuDelegateV2Create.

methods.name: tflite_plugin_create_delegate
methods.description: Creates a delegate using plugin options specified by key-value pairs and reports errors via a callback.

methods.name: tflite_plugin_destroy_delegate
methods.description: Destroys a delegate created with tflite_plugin_create_delegate.
